On the efficacy of singing Śiva's name
Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa wrote a commentary (vyākhyā) on it, called Mādhuryajharī.

V. Raghavan mentions a commentary on it by a certain Vīrarāghava. This Vīrarāghava did not live in Śrīdhara's time but, according to Raghavan, is an author 'of the last century'. See Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952: p. 63 and 43.
